expectations.evidence: Defines --color-primary, --color-surface etc. in theme.css on :root and [data-theme='dark']; all components use var(--color-*)
Explicitly states '::ng-deep is unnecessary for custom properties'; none in code
ThemeService with toggle(), setMode(), and effect() managing data-theme attribute; ThemeToggleComponent provides Light/System/Dark toggle
No ViewEncapsulation.None/ShadowDom; detailed explanation of how emulated encapsulation does not interfere with var() resolution
CardComponent uses var(--color-surface), var(--color-on-surface), var(--color-outline); ButtonComponent uses var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary)
